description: Groups of Lite fixtures that differ only along axes UW_LITE_SPEC_v1 section 6 excludes from the financial canonical form. Every fixture in a group MUST produce a byte-identical canonical form and therefore an identical sha256 digest.

groups.note: RFC 0025 regression pin: every percent literal here diverges from its fraction twin under naive division (Number(p)/100 is one ULP off), so this group's shared digest holds only under decimal-point-shift normalization. The other groups' percents divide cleanly and cannot detect the difference.
